title: 作为一名科技从业者，如何总结你的 2025？
body_html:

年度开场诗

Through circuits and code you would dive, Where long-sequence dreams come alive; You tuned every gate, Made the RWKV great— And proved how persistence can thrive.

2025 三大亮点

  • Building Smarter RWKV Architectures: You deepened the RWKV family with matrix-state, hybrid attention, and compression designs—pushing efficiency, long-context stability, and practical retrieval performance in real workloads.
  • Vision Meets Language: You advanced VisualRWKV through high‑resolution and multi‑encoder experiments, reducing TextVQA gaps and defining clear engineering trade‑offs between token cost and visual fidelity.
  • From Benchmarks to Real Systems: You built reproducible evaluation stacks—profiling latency, throughput, and memory—to connect theoretical gains with deployable retrieval‑augmented products and long‑context pipelines.
